inputs.record_ids: explicit nonempty ordered sequence of distinct canonical record IDs
inputs.rights_policy: explicit mapping of source rights reference to permitted export purposes
inputs.allow_simulated: boolean, false by default; true only for an isolated simulation purpose
inputs.max_documents: positive integer, default and hard ceiling 4096
inputs.max_document_bytes: positive integer, default and hard ceiling 1048576
inputs.max_total_bytes: positive integer, default and hard ceiling 67108864

outputs.documents: ordered immutable tuple of the verified exact extracted text; never source URLs or digest placeholders
outputs.manifest_digest: sha256 of canonical JSON manifest fields, including ordered source sample identities
outputs.corpus_digest: sha256 of UTF-8 newline-joined documents, preserving the native trainer compatibility contract
outputs.document_sequence_digest: sha256 of canonical JSON document array with ensure_ascii=false and compact separators; disambiguates document boundaries
outputs.text_digest: sha256 of each exact UTF-8 extracted document

invariants: Cheap projected-document bounds are admitted before source hashing/scanning; cumulative original source bytes have a fixed 536870912-byte verification ceiling.
Export validates issued record identity, original content bytes, intake provenance and extracted text digests before exposing documents.
Record IDs must be explicit and ordered; strings, mappings, sets, generators, missing IDs and duplicate normalized IDs fail closed.
Repeated original asset identities in one export are rejected to avoid ambiguous duplicate source projections.
Records without verified TextProjection cannot export binary media as trainable text.
Every rights reference on every selected record must explicitly permit the exact declared purpose.
Simulation purposes require allow_simulated=true and exclusively simulated records; ordinary purposes reject simulated records and simulation opt-in.
All documents remain untrusted evidence and never gain instruction authority.
Instruction-shaped source or extracted text is rejected rather than promoted into normal model-training evidence.
Export has strict count, per-document and aggregate UTF-8 byte ceilings; booleans, invalid or above-ceiling limits are rejected.
The manifest validates ordered per-document hashes, byte counts and both sequence digests before governed dataset ingestion.
Export IDs are idempotent only for the exact manifest and document sequence; conflicting reuse does not modify issued exports or source corpus state.
Governed native dataset ingestion owns persistent dataset versions, quality, split materialization and train/evaluation isolation; this exporter creates no new tenant boundary or durable store.
failure_contract: MultimodalFoundationError with no export publication or mutation of corpus, intake, content store or earlier issued export
rollback: Disable text-training export while retaining original assets, issued records, projection receipts and governed dataset versions.
